terra.problem: The Josiah moment includes the removal of idolatrous priests, but its cited passage does not. Add 2 Kings 23:5 to the passage or remove that detail.
The Rehoboam fortification moment says he strengthened the cities’ walls. 2 Chronicles 11:11 says he strengthened their fortifications, without specifying walls.
Words such as “fortifies,” “idolatrous,” and “mediums” may be difficult for fifth-grade readers. Use simpler wording or briefly explain them.
